steps.sub: becomes a ticket worked during business hours

eyebrow: Why one person can't do it all

steps.label: Incident Commander
steps.sub: owns the incident and the resolution call, not the keyboard

steps.label: Technical Lead + Communications Lead
steps.sub: one investigates, one handles outward updates

steps.label: Scribe
steps.sub: keeps the real-time log the postmortem will depend on

eyebrow: An illustrative SEV1, minute by minute
code:
00:00 Alert fires: checkout success < 97% (SLO: 99.9%)
00:04 Incident declared SEV1; IC assigned
00:12 Technical Lead identifies a deploy as the cause
00:15 Rollback initiated
00:24 Success rate back above 99.9% — mitigated
00:40 Sustained normal behavior confirmed — closed
caption: Mitigated means the symptom stopped; closed means it's confirmed staying stopped.
